facts.fact: Nejjarine is a former funduq/caravanserai converted to a museum of wooden arts and crafts. The historic lodging/trading building and its courtyard are part of the visit.

facts.fact: The described collection themes are domestic, architectural and liturgical uses of wood, with tools and woodworking/cabinetmaking pieces.
